title: Stop strict test evidence from rejecting a shard whose successor-launch test ran but lacks a per-file summary
body:
Outcome: a shard where every test passed is accepted by the strict evidence check.
Evidence: run 42486987437 (PR #422, 5175404), job Test 9/10: 168/168 passed, then "Strict test evidence rejected: missing per-file summary: test/claude/successor-launch.test.ts"; the JSON summary lists that file with tests: 0 while the timing table shows its test ran (1.144 s). Main runs for 4b8b232 and earlier were green, so it is intermittent.
Acceptance: a regression test reproduces a per-file summary missing for a file whose test ran, and the reporter or validator handles it; no retry policy.
